Add the first wait/yield behaviour for durable runs. Add a `wait_for` tool (`src/tools/wait-for.ts`) that waits for a future time/duration or for an active managed job; it persists the wait as a timer in the run store and returns a typed yield signal (`waitRequest` on `ToolOutput`, see `src/tools/registry.ts`). The executor records the tool result before transitioning the run to `waiting`. The agent loop (`src/agent/loop.ts`) must end the turn right after appending that tool result: run `onIterationEnd` so state is persisted, emit a new `onRunYield` callback, and fire the Stop hook without issuing another model request.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/agent/loop.test.ts`, `src/runs/executor-journal.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/agent/loop.test.ts src/runs/executor-journal.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
